$comment: How moving water shows its flow (docs/WATER_SURFACE_GRID.md §2c G3d; owner, 2026-11-05: ripples that move with the current, foam streaks along it and particles drifting on it, each one a setting). The current is the water's, from the one current table (the grid's free water by the law, an untouched river's by the map), so water a player set moving and water the generator made look alike. windowColumns: the columns square around the eye the flow texture holds (a power of two; it wraps as the eye moves, 1 texel a column); rangeMs: the fastest current it holds (m/s; faster is clamped); fadeFromM, fadeToM: the flow shows fully within the first and fades out by the second (m from the eye; under half the window). liquids: per liquid (its fluid's name in the block registry; a liquid not listed shows no flow): ripples.advect, how far the ripples are carried per metre the water moves (1: with it), ripples.cycleS, the seconds the shader carries a ripple before it blends in afresh (shorter: less stretched, more often renewed); foam.fromMs and foam.toMs, the current where streaks begin and where they are full (from 0.05 m/s since 0.49.21, owner 2026-11-06: slow creeks of ~0.1 m/s showed no flow at all); foam.color (sRGB) and foam.strength (0 to 1, at full); foam.lengthM and foam.widthM, a streak's size along and across the flow (lengthM at most 4.5 widthM: the shader's six taps along it must join, or a streak breaks into round blobs, the owner's 'perfect white circles' of 2026-11-06);particles (owner, 2026-11-06: not 'perfect white circles' but bits of foam carried by the current): particles.count, how many drift near the eye at most (cpuCount on a CPU adapter); particles.fromMs, the least current they are spawned and shown in, and fullMs, the current where they are spawned as often and shown as strongly as they get (fewer and fainter between); particles.sizeM, a fleck's half-width across the flow (m), and stretch, its length over its width at fullMs (1 at fromMs); particles.color (sRGB) and opacity, its most (0 to 1; lit as the water's surface is, shadows included); particles.lifeS, how long one drifts, fading in over its first fadeInS and out over its last fadeOutS; particles.radiusM, how far from the eye they are spawned; particles.ragged, how far its edge is broken (0: an ellipse, 1: torn) and lumps, the lobes round its edge (0 to 8); particles.minPixels, its width on screen (px) under which it fades out (gone at half that: no shimmer far off). shore (docs/WATER_RENDERING.md §13; owner, 2026-11-10: 'more like pulsing bands'): foam where the water meets land or a block, by the distance to the shore (the depth over a slope, the ray's path through the water to a wall), out to the fluid's foam depth (block registry `foam.depth`): shore.lineM, a solid contact line's width (m); shore.bands, how many soft bands roll out from the shore at once (0 to 4), each born at the edge and rolling out over shore.periodS seconds, thinning from shore.widthM and fading; shore.wobble (0 to 1), how far slow noise shifts each band's timing and width along the shore (never a hole); shore.strength, the foam's most (0 to 1). A CPU adapter's tier (Low) draws no shore foam. Run `node shared/look/waterflow.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/waterflow.gen.rs is stale.
